capabilities: Collapse both sidebars when a Thino view becomes the active tab
Restore both sidebars when switching to any other tab
Skip collapsing on windows wider than a configurable threshold
Leave manually opened or closed sidebars untouched between tab switches
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.2.8 or newer; the author notes the plugin may break if a future Thino release renames the view types it matches. README includes a Chinese-language section and release/build details.
intentEvidence: The plugin matches the view types thino_view and thino-super-view that Thino registers.
motivation: The README frames the pain: 'While you are writing there, the file explorer and the backlink panes are just taking up room.'
problem: While writing in Thino's quick-capture view, the file explorer and backlink panes take up room and must be collapsed and reopened by hand each time.
summary: Collapses both sidebars while a Thino view is the active tab on windows below a width threshold, and restores them when you switch away.
